rows.note: Use this for keeping equipment, vehicles, or property in good working order.

example.english: We need to maintain the car regularly so it will last.
example.traditional: 架車要定期保養，先至襟用。
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 jiu3 ding6 kei4 bou2 joeng5 sin1 zi3 kam1 jung6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for actively sustaining an ongoing state, level, system, or relationship.

example.english: The government must maintain normal public transport operations.
example.traditional: 政府要維持公共交通正常運作。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 jiu3 wai4 ci4 gung1 gung6 gaau1 tung1 zing3 soeng4 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on preserving something as it is, including keeping in contact.

example.english: Although we work for different companies, we still maintain contact.
example.traditional: 大家雖然唔同公司做，但仲保持聯絡。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 seoi1 jin4 m4 tung4 gung1 si1 zou6 daan6 zung6 bou2 ci4 lyun4 lok3

rows.note: Use this in more formal contexts when someone asserts or claims that a statement is true.

example.english: They maintain that the new system can maintain service stability.
example.traditional: 佢哋聲稱新系統可以維持服務穩定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 sing1 cing1 san1 hai6 tung2 ho2 ji5 wai4 ci4 fuk6 mou6 wan2 ding6
